messages:
Maria R.: Heads up team — planning a staged v2 traffic flip for api.redwood.com in the Tue 02:00 UTC change window. Rollout plan: phase A 10% (30m) -> phase B 50% (60m) -> phase C 100% (90m). Intent is region-first (EU -> US -> APAC).
DeployBot: scheduled rollout: rollout/v2-flip id=roll_2026_06_?? time=2026-06-02T02:00:00Z stages=[10,50,100] regions=[eu,us,apac] operator=@maria_r
Aj: Thanks. Can we stagger EU small tenants first? want to warm caches and kv.
Maria R.: yes — EU will get a 10% cohort composed of low-traffic tenants then expand. Aj can you add the tenant list to the pinlist?
Aj: will do. uploading pinned tenant file to /releases/v2/pinlists/eu-warmup.txt and add to deploy args.
Robin: SDK note — we shipped a client toggle in sdk-js v1.2.3 that sets X-RI-Client-Version. Older SDKs won't send it; we'll rely on header-based pin for them. I posted the SDK release notes: https://internal.docs/redwood/sdk-js/1.2.3
Sam: I'll prep a short support playbook and canned messages for the first 2 stages. Adding link to doc channel when ready.
Taylor: Oncall ack. Monitoring checklist: p95 latency, 5xx rate, client-telemetry success rate, token generation errors. Ops thresholds: p95 increase >200ms sustained 10m => investigate, 5xx rate >2% sustained 5m => rollback.
Maria R.: Rollback criteria proposal (finalizing):
- Sustained 5xx >2% for 5m
- p95 latency +200ms baseline for 10m
- Drop in telemetry success (successful inference responses) by >3% across tenants for 10m
If any trigger fires we roll back the last stage and open an incident channel.
Priya: Notifying top 10 enterprise tenants and posting changelog in customer portal. Also updating release notes with known client compatibility caveat.
Aj: For pinning older SDKs — plan is to use header fallback + deploybot pinlist. Deploy command will include --pinfile eu-warmup.txt --legacy-header-mode=accept
Robin: Example deploy command I tested locally:
```
deploybot rollout create --id roll_2026_06_02_v2flip \
  --stages 10,50,100 \
  --regions eu,us,apac \
  --pinfile /releases/v2/pinlists/eu-warmup.txt \
  --operator maria_r
```
DeployBot: acknowledged. Will emit stage-start and stage-complete events to this channel during rollout and will attach telemetry snapshot per stage.
Sam: Added initial support playbook draft: https://internal.docs/redwood/playbooks/v2-rollout-playbook.md — includes customer messages + rollback steps.
Taylor: I'll temp bump alert sensitivity for the window and keep mobile oncall looped in.
Maria R.: Final checklist before flip:
- Aj: confirm pinlist uploaded (done?)
- Robin: confirm docs + SDK note published (done)
- Sam: playbook link (done)
- DeployBot: scheduled (ack)
- Priya: customer notifications queued (done)
Everyone: call to arms at -15m in this thread.
Aj: pinlist uploaded and gzipped.
Robin: docs published.
Sam: playbook in place and support rota assigned.
DeployBot: reminder will post at 2026-06-02T01:45:00Z (-15m).
Priya: sending notice to enterprise tenants now.
Maria R.: thanks — let's be ready. :thumbsup:
